SELECT COUNT(u.user_no) FROM sys_tenant_user_group ug LEFT JOIN sys_tenant_user u ON u.id = ug.user_id LEFT JOIN sys_tenant_user_position up ON u.id = up.user_id AND up.group_id = ug.group_id LEFT JOIN sys_tenant_position p ON up.position_id = p.id
ug.group_id = #{groupId,jdbcType=CHAR} and u.tenant_id = #{tenantId,jdbcType=CHAR}

SELECT DISTINCT u.id, u.user_no, u.user_real_cn_name, u.user_real_en_name, u.user_sex, u.user_email, u.user_tag, u.expire_time, u.create_time, u.state, u.avatar, u.note FROM sys_tenant_user u WHERE u.tenant_id = #{tenantId,jdbcType=CHAR} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT user_id FROM sys_tenant_user_group ug WHERE ug.user_id = u.id)
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM sys_tenant_user u WHERE u.tenant_id = #{tenantId,jdbcType=CHAR} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT user_id FROM sys_tenant_user_group ug WHERE ug.user_id = u.id)

SELECT u.id, u.user_no, u.user_real_cn_name, u.user_real_en_name, ug.group_id, u.state FROM sys_tenant_user u INNER JOIN sys_tenant_user_group ug ON ug.user_id = u.id WHERE u.tenant_id = #{tenantId,jdbcType=CHAR}

SELECT u.id,u.user_no,u.user_real_cn_name,u.user_real_en_name,g.group_id, g.group_name FROM sys_tenant_user u INNER JOIN sys_tenant_user_group ug ON ug.user_id = u.id INNER JOIN sys_tenant_group g ON g.id = ug.group_id WHERE u.state IN ('ACTIVE','STOPPED') AND u.be_search = 1 and u.tenant_id = #{tenantId,jdbcType=CHAR}
AND FIND_IN_SET(#{userTag},u.user_tag)
AND (u.user_real_cn_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{KeyWord},'%') OR u.user_real_en_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{KeyWord},'%') OR u.pin_yin LIKE CONCAT('%',#{KeyWord},'%') OR u.full_pin_yin LIKE CONCAT('%',#{KeyWord},'%') OR u.user_no LIKE CONCAT('%',#{KeyWord},'%'))
LIMIT 10

SELECT u.id,u.user_no,u.user_real_cn_name,u.user_real_en_name, ug.group_id FROM sys_tenant_user u INNER JOIN sys_tenant_user_group ug ON ug.user_id = u.id WHERE state = 'ACTIVE' and u.tenant_id = #{tenantId,jdbcType=CHAR}
AND FIND_IN_SET(#{userTag},user_tag)
